strategies.rules:
BUY on 15-min candles when: 20-candle stochastic %K is above 89  AND  50-candle stochastic %K is above 93  AND  distance above the 24-candle swing low (ATRs) is above 5.2875
EXIT: take-profit 5.04 ATR, stop-loss 1.48 ATR, trailing stop 2.57 ATR, when 3-candle momentum (vol-adjusted) is above 1.8, after 48 candles, always before the close   (max 3 trades per stock per day)
